vulnerability_cn: 例外债券总数检查不能保证逐项匹配
vulnerability_en: Aggregate exception counts fail to enforce per-bond multiplicity
detail_cn: exchangeEquivalentBonds 对例外债券只累计匹配次数，不能保证每个 bondID 在输入、输出各出现正确次数。攻击交易在两套独立 BondMaker 部署登记输出组，重复列出属于例外列表的 bondID；例外列表本身没有重复。合约跳过输入销毁却铸造新债券，再通过三个 OTC 付款端点卖出。完整跟踪和转账复算显示，持有 USDC 的已授权流动性提供者钱包共向攻击合约支付 532,070.026484、74.602120、10,000 USDC，攻击者最终收到 542,144.628604 USDC。两套 BondMaker 不是代理与实现关系；未重放。CSV 保留源表约 542,000 美元口径。
detail_en: exchangeEquivalentBonds balances aggregate exception-match counts without enforcing each bondID's correct input/output multiplicity. On two independent BondMaker deployments, the transaction registered output groups that repeat bondIDs from the exception list; the exception list itself has no duplicates. It minted bonds through the skipped-burn path and sold them through three OTC payment endpoints. Complete traces and transfer reconciliation show an approved USDC liquidity-provider wallet paid the attack contract 532,070.026484, 74.602120 and 10,000 USDC; the attacker received 542,144.628604 USDC. The two BondMakers are separate deployments, not a proxy/implementation pair. No replay was run. CSV loss retains the sheet's approximate USD 542,000 scope.
loss_scope: Approximate source-sheet USD loss; independently reconciled transaction payments total 542144.628604 USDC.
